title: ErrataRecord
description: Schema for a single erratum file at context/research/errata/{erratum_id}.json.

erratum_id.description: Unique identifier for the erratum (e.g., ERR-2026-08-001).

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was written.

date_identified.description: Date when the erroneous data was identified.

target_file.description: Relative file path containing the erroneous or outdated claim.

target_field_or_claim.description: The specific field, metric, catalyst date, or analytical assumption that was incorrect.

erroneous_value.description: The incorrect data point or statement.

corrected_value.description: The verified replacement data point or statement.

authoritative_source_citation.description: Primary authoritative reference used to verify the correction.

identifying_agent_or_human.description: Role of the agent or human reviewer who detected the error.

correction_action_taken.description: Summary of updates made to active dossiers, schemas, or script caches.

related_run_id.description: Optional link to context/research/runs/{run_id}.json that detected or resolved this erratum.

related_ids.description: Cross-links to other ERR-* or superseding records.
